about: Smart stream choice words (plans/m13-stream-choice.md 3.7, 3.9, 3.11, 4.4, 4.5), shared by the web, Android and Apple apps. A line's details are parts joined with ", "; a part shows only when every field it names is known, and the joined details start with a capital letter. Counts use the plurals below and group thousands with a comma. Sizes use 1024-based units, as addons print them: one decimal under 100 GB with a trailing .0 dropped, whole numbers from 100 GB, MB under 1 GB. Mbit/s are whole numbers.

copy.text: Recorded in a cinema, low quality

fetch.text: Not ready yet, has to download first

otherYear.text: May be a different film or show

details: Needs about {need} Mbit/s; this connection gives about {have} ({speedSource})

size.up: On {device} you often picked bigger files, so Marquee now picks files up to {limit}.
size.down: On {device} you often picked smaller files, so Marquee now picks files up to {limit}.

height.up: On {device} you often picked sharper versions, so Marquee now picks up to {height}.
height.down: On {device} you often picked lower resolutions, so Marquee now picks up to {height}.

ready.up: On {device} you often picked files ready on your streaming service, so Marquee now prefers them.
ready.down: On {device} you often picked torrents over ready files, so Marquee now treats them like the rest.

hdr.down: On {device} you often picked versions without HDR, so Marquee now leaves HDR off.

question.title: How should Marquee pick what to play?
question.lead: You can change this later in Settings, under Stream choice.
